blocks.text: Cebu City, Philippines — The National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) is placing the Visayas Grid on a yellow alert from 5:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. today, September 26, 2026. The unavailability of three large coal plants (TVI 1, PEDC 3, and KSPC 2) has led to the continued low capacity, prompting the NGCP to raise the alert. READ: Groups urge DOE chief to quit amid Visayas power crisis As of 8:00 a.m., the grid has 2,540 megawatts (MW) of available capacity to handle a peak demand of 2,312 MW.
